issue: Some configuration frozen_utc strings were manually estimated a few minutes ahead of actual execution. These strings are not authoritative measurements of freeze time.
general_policy: All hand-entered frozen_utc fields in this semantic cohort are approximate author annotations, not clock measurements. Use the supervisor timestamps and exact configuration hashes for chronology.
authoritative_boundary: Each runner reads the complete configuration, hashes it, copies CONFIG.json and freezes executed_source before importing native preparation code and before creating or advancing its Runtime. The original supervisor started_utc and immutable per-case configuration_sha256 identify that boundary.
preservation: Original configuration bytes and all primary results are retained. No results, decoder, reserve histories or acceptance conditions were altered to correct these clerical timestamp strings.
not_claimed: No exact UTC configuration freeze earlier than the supervisor command is inferred from the erroneous manually entered field. Source/config ordering is established by executed runner control flow and matching hashes.
